summary.zh: 以 LP 视角筛查私募项目条款与费用结构
summary.en: Screens a private deal from a limited partner's view

description.zh: 当有人推荐一笔私募交易时，从有限合伙人视角做压力测试，计算管理费和业绩分成对收益的拖累，并与同类基准比较条款。适合在决定是否参与 syndication、优先股、过桥基金或私募信贷前做初步筛查。
description.en: Screens a private deal as an LP: stress-tests the numbers, computes fee drag and compares terms against benchmarks. Useful before committing to a syndication, preferred equity, bridge fund or private credit offer.
